fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/daemon/... -run QueueWait: appended lines read back oldest first with every field; a malformed line between two good ones is skipped; a missing file reads as no lines; lines appended from several goroutines at once each read back whole
fields.statement: internal/daemon defines the queue-wait journal's line (at, change, title, reason, detail), appends one to queue.wait.jsonl in the daemon's folder under the git common dir with a single write per line, and reads the file back as every line oldest first, skipping lines that do not parse

fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... -run QueueWait: polls that skip a change set for no-slot twice, then for usage-reserve, then for load-high under a machine hold, then start it journal exactly four lines (no-slot, usage-reserve, load-high, started) with its change, title and detail; a change set started on its first poll journals only a started line; a fresh daemon over the same journal writes no line for an unchanged reason
fields.statement: Each daemon poll appends a queue-wait line for an accepted change set only when its wait changes: when a poll first skips it, with the poll's Skip reason and detail (no-slot, not-ready, held, unjournaled, disk-low, load-high, memory-low, usage-reserve, paused, ship-owner, workflow-unresolved and the rest), when its reason changes, and a started line when the daemon starts its run; the last reason per change set is taken from the journal, so a restarted daemon writes no duplicate line
